lesson.subtitle: Lesson 3 -- What Do You Do?
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Ender de Souza Batista | Lesson 3 -- What Do You Do?
lesson.grammar_point: present simple with I, you, we and they (affirmative, do/don't negative and Do you...? questions)

listenings.text: Hi, I'm Kate. I work at a bank in Chicago. I manage the credit card team. We are ten people. We work with stores and with other banks. I don't travel a lot for work. I work in the office on Mondays and Tuesdays, and I work from home on Fridays. I love my job, but I don't love Monday mornings!

Hello, my name is Tom. I live in London, and I'm a software developer. I build software for payments: for banks and for online stores. I don't manage people. I like that! I work on a small team, and we have a lot of calls with partners in the US and in India. I work from home on Mondays and Fridays.

extra_audio.text: Ender and Jessica are online before the meeting. Jessica says: We send text messages for big companies. Ender asks: What do you do at TextFlow? Jessica says: I manage the projects for new clients. Ender says: We don't send text messages. We need a provider.
